name: threadsafecache

examples.title: Example

features: **Generics.** Values are stored without boxing through `interface{}`.
**LRU bound.** When the cache fills, the least-recently-used entry is evicted. (`hashicorp/golang-lru/v2` does the heavy lifting.)
**TTL.** Entries older than the TTL miss on `Get` and are evicted as a side effect of being touched. Set TTL to `0` to disable expiry and use the cache as pure LRU.

**Lock everything.** All operations take the same `sync.Mutex` — hashicorp's LRU mutates internal state on `Get` (recency tracking), so splitting reads and writes is unsafe in general. The result is simple and race-clean.
